reason: The three one-entry proposals describe the same helper rewrite, so keep them adjacent and count them as one experiment: it reuses the supplied panel computation while removing repeated SME transitions, though assembly and ABI risks are high and benefit is unmeasured. Scratch reuse and packed-B traversal are distinct but require coordinated pointer, layout, and traversal changes. Transpose fusion has high assembly risk; a_transpose also needs an unavailable generated shape. The three proposed 256-iteration loop changes are duplicates, and their premise conflicts with the supplied full512 loop: each iteration loads one K step's operand vectors, then updates all four ZA tiles. Halving the count would omit K steps. Rank these last; do not implement them as described.
